messages:
Mina (Design): quick UX check on the vectors preview + rerank table — uploaded a tiny gif. Main asks: keep export selection when users toggle sampling, clarify the rerank relevance score label, and fix keyboard focus for the inspector. https://rwd-assets/vec-preview-clip.gif Carlos (Eng): watched. Selection persistence is fine (we can keep id set). caveat: if sampling removes the row entirely, selection should still survive but show as hidden. Jules (PM): agree. show a pill: "23 selected (4 hidden) • View hidden" — clicking View hidden should reveal them in context. Mina (Design): copy tweak: relevance column currently labeled "score" — suggest "relevance (0-1)" to reduce confusion. Also add tooltip: "Higher = more relevant to your query". Sam (Accessibility): a11y notes: keyboard focus currently lands on the export CTA then skips table rows. Use roving tabindex so arrow keys move through rows and Enter/Space toggles selection. Also ensure tooltips are accessible (aria-describedby). Carlos (Eng): implementation note: we'll implement selectedSet + hiddenCount. For keyboard: roving tabindex + aria-selected. For tooltips we'll attach to a button with aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip element. Mina (Design): UI decision: when user changes rerank model, do we auto-apply or staged until Apply clicked? I'm leaning staged with an unsaved indicator so they can preview without surprising downstream export results. Jules (PM): staged is safer. add an 'Apply rerank' button and show a tiny dot on it when there are unapplied changes. Also include a message when exporting: "Export will use the currently applied rerank model". Carlos (Eng): backend: we'll keep preview scores calculated client-side for staged changes, but export job will reference server-side model id from active state. That avoids inconsistency. Sam (Accessibility): small code snippet for aria-live count updates: ```
Showing 50 vectors
``` Make sure it updates only when number changes, not on every keypress. NotifyBot: Rerank model switched to rerank-v2-staging by Jules (PM). Mina (Design): thanks, i'll adjust the mock: rename column to 'relevance (0-1)', add tooltip copy, selection banner, staged apply flow, and keyboard states. Posting v2 in ~90 mins. Jules (PM): adding acceptance criteria to PR: selection persists across sampling, relevance label & tooltip, roving keyboard nav, staged rerank apply, aria-live updates. Carlos (Eng): noted. will sync with QA once mock v2 is up.
